item.title: “I’m the real victim in all this,” insists man forced to live in slightly less opulent surroundings
item.description: A man who once lived in a 30-room mansion has bravely spoken out about his ordeal after being asked to move into a different royal property that is, by some cruel twist of fate, marginally less grand.

item.title: Peter Mandelson announced as first contestant in new series of Celebrity Traitors
item.description: Disgraced former Minister and Peer Peter Mandelson has been announced as the first contestant in the next series of Celebrity Traitors.

item.title: “Actors should stay out of politics, except for intellectual titan Holly Valance,” insist Reform voters
item.description: In an abrupt U-Turn, Reform supporter Simon Williams, formerly a passionate advocate of celebrities shutting the fuck up on matters of state, has granted Holly Valance a license to speak freely.

item.title: Labour relieved Mandelson’s resignation ‘to avoid causing further embarrassment’ prevented further embarrassment
item.description: Labour and Keir Starmer’s government are grateful for disgraced peer Peter Mandelson resigning at the start of the week because he didn’t want to ‘cause further embarrassment.’

item.title: “We had no way of knowing man forced to resign twice for corruption would be corrupt” insists Starmer
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has reminded everyone that there was no way of knowing that a man who was forced to resign from government office twice for corruption would turn out to be corrupt.

item.title: Man now only 12 lbs away from achieving New Year’s Resolution to lose 10 lbs
item.description: After stepping on the scales this morning, Basingstoke resident Simon Williams has confirmed he is now just 12 lbs away from achieving his New Year's resolution to lose 10 lbs.

item.title: Man who buried his cash in a sock at the bottom of his garden once again outperforms Bitcoin
item.description: A man who chose to bury cash in his garden is once again outperforming pretty much every 'crypto-guru' who will no doubt find their way into the social media comments around this article.

item.title: Morgan McSweeney to recommend Gary Glitter as new US Ambassador
item.description: The Prime Minister’s chief of staff Morgan McSweeney has advised Keir Starmer to appoint Gary Glitter as the new US ambassador, after his vetting process came back completely clean.

item.title: Grima Wormtongue’s links to Saruman the White ‘didn’t raise alarms’ during vetting process
item.description: Grima Wormtongue being a tool of the will of Saruman of Isengard was overlooked in the haste to appoint him as main advisor to King Theoden of Rohan, according to reports today.

item.title: “I don’t look at half the sh*t I share online”, insists Trump
item.description: Donald Trump has reassured supporters that he is deeply offended anyone would assume he watches or reads any of the things he posts online, explaining that if he did that, he’d “never get any posting done”.
